description: Explain an e-invoicing business rule by its id, such as BR-CO-15, BR-DE-1, PEPPOL-EN16931-R001 or a national CIUS rule: its message, level, the rule sets it belongs to, why invoices fail it and how to fix them. No sign-in or API key needed.

id.description: The rule id as the validator reports it, such as BR-CO-15.

name: explain_rule
title: Explain a business rule
